name: Allow to open chat properties in browser session
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Request:** Expose chat properties from the browser-session chat, plus fix chats that belong to no board (they must land in the virtual "Unassigned" board) and add a chat/task searcher to the kanban list.
2. **Investigation:** Located the key files — `src/store/kanban.js` (already defines `NO_BOARD_ID = 'Unassigned'` / `NO_COLUMN_ID`, synthesized virtual board), `src/store/browsers.js`, `src/components/browsers/BrowserSessionPanel.vue`, `src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue` (board/column editor), `KanbanList.vue` (board filter input) and `src/api/modules/chats.js` (search endpoint).
3. **Follow-up request:** Allow navigating from the docked browser-session chat to that chat through the `$ui` store (`$storex.ui.openChat`), which already picks a dockview panel on desktop or the chat route on mobile.
4. **Proposed changes:** Add `openChatInMainView()` to `BrowserSessionPanel.vue` (closes the chat switcher, then delegates to `$storex.ui.openChat(this.browserChat)`) and a desktop-only icon button (`fa-arrow-up-right-from-square`, disabled when no chat/loading) in the docked chat header.
5. **Status:** Design/implementation plan for the navigation button is complete and awaiting confirmation; the original board-less chat fix and kanban searcher were analyzed but their code changes were not yet written.

Delegates to the UI store, the single place that decides between * both, so the same conversation keeps its own panel/route and the browser * pane here stays untouched. */ openChatInMainView() { const chat = this.browserChat if (!chat?.id) return // The switcher would otherwise stay floating over the newly opened view. this.showChatMenu = false this.$storex.ui.openChat(chat) }, ``` `src/components/browsers/BrowserSessionPanel.vue` — header button, inserted after the tools/`AI` badge (currently lines 1140‑1146) and before the `` comment: ```html ``` ### 4.
